english.title: Contravene provision of Cosmetics Regulation - breach article 3 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 10 / 14 / 15 / 18 / 19 / 20 / 23
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened article

(A)_[3 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to safety,]_
(B)_[5 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to obligations of responsible persons,]_
(C)_[6 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to obligations of distributors,]_
(D)_[7 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to identification within the supply chain,]_
(E)_[10 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to safety assessment,]_
(F)_[14 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to restrictions for substances,]_
(G)_[15 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to substances classified as CMR substances,]_
(H)_[18 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to animal testing requirements,]_
(I)_[19 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to labelling requirements,]_
(J)_[20 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to requirements relating to product claims,]_
(K)_[23 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to communication of serious undesirable effects,]_

in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(1) and 13(1) of the Cosmetic Products Enforcement Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravened
article 3, 5, 6, 7, 10, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20 or 23 of Cosmetics Regulation

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 24 of the Cosmetic Products Enforcement Regulations 2013 for liability of other persons.
(iv) See regulation 23 for the defence of due diligence.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex, see regulation 22.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
